/-! Entire represented exponential obtained from agreeing factorial-series
charts. Every point has an executable evaluator; internal chart radii are hidden. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert

/-- A chart large enough for the actual input's initial rational box. -/
def exponentialInputRadius (z : Scalar) : QPos :=
  ⟨LocalODE.boxCoordinateBound (z.val.compute 0)+1,
    by have h := LocalODE.boxCoordinateBound_nonneg (z.val.compute 0); grind only⟩

theorem exponentialInputRadius_mem (z : Scalar) :
    (exponentialChart (exponentialInputRadius z)).domain z := by
  refine ⟨LocalODE.boxCoordinateBound (z.val.compute 0),
    LocalODE.boxCoordinateBound_nonneg _, ?_, LocalODE.small_from_box z.val z.property 0⟩
  change LocalODE.boxCoordinateBound (z.val.compute 0) <
    LocalODE.boxCoordinateBound (z.val.compute 0)+1
  grind only

/-- The value is computed using a certified chart chosen from the input box. -/
def entireExponentialValue (z : Scalar) : Scalar :=
  ⟨(exponentialChart (exponentialInputRadius z)).eval z,
    (exponentialChart (exponentialInputRadius z)).valid z (exponentialInputRadius_mem z)⟩

theorem entireExponentialValue_congr (z w : Scalar) (hzw : z.val.Equiv w.val) :
    (entireExponentialValue z).val.Equiv (entireExponentialValue w).val :=
  exponentialChart_agreement _ _ z w (exponentialInputRadius_mem z) (exponentialInputRadius_mem w) hzw

def entireExponential : DomainFunctions.Map where
  domain _ := True
  eval z _ := entireExponentialValue z
  domain_congr _ _ _ := Iff.rfl
  eval_congr z w _ _ hzw := entireExponentialValue_congr z w hzw

/-- Every supplied exponential chart agrees with the global evaluator. -/
theorem entireExponential_chart (R : QPos) (z : Scalar) (hz : (exponentialChart R).domain z) :
    ((exponentialChart R).eval z).Equiv (entireExponentialValue z).val :=
  exponentialChart_agreement R (exponentialInputRadius z) z z hz
    (exponentialInputRadius_mem z) (equiv_refl _ z.property)

/-- Actual holomorphicity on all valid represented complex inputs, derived
from local derivatives and proved overlap agreement. -/
def entireExponential_holomorphic : DomainFunctions.Holomorphic entireExponential :=
  DomainFunctions.holomorphic_of_local entireExponential
    (fun a _ => DomainFunctions.ofCertified (exponentialChart (exponentialInputRadius a)))
    (fun a _ => DomainFunctions.ofCertifiedHolomorphic (exponentialChart_holomorphic (exponentialInputRadius a)))
    (fun a _ => exponentialInputRadius_mem a)
    (fun _ _ _ _ => trivial)
    (fun a _ z hz => entireExponential_chart (exponentialInputRadius a) z hz)

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.ExponentialMajorant

/-! Actual holomorphic exponential-series charts at every positive rational
radius, with exact overlap agreement between all radius choices. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert

def exponentialRatio (R : QPos) : Rat := 1/(32*R.val)

theorem exponentialRatio_positive (R : QPos) : 0 < exponentialRatio R := by
  unfold exponentialRatio
  rw [Rat.div_def, Rat.one_mul]
  exact Rat.inv_pos.mpr (Rat.mul_pos (by decide +kernel) R.property)

theorem exponentialRatio_local (R : QPos) : 8*exponentialRatio R*R.val ≤ (1 : Rat)/2 := by
  have hp : 0 < 32*R.val := Rat.mul_pos (by decide +kernel) R.property
  have hc := Rat.mul_inv_cancel (32*R.val) (Rat.ne_of_gt hp)
  unfold exponentialRatio
  rw [Rat.div_def, Rat.one_mul]
  grind

def exponentialChart (R : QPos) : CertifiedFunctions.Map :=
  BoundedSeries.seriesMap exponentialCoefficients exponentialCoefficients_valid
    (exponentialBudget (exponentialRatio R)) (exponentialRatio R) R.val
    (exponentialBudget_nonnegative _ (exponentialRatio_positive R))
    (Rat.le_of_lt (exponentialRatio_positive R)) (Rat.le_of_lt R.property)
    (exponentialCoefficients_small _ (exponentialRatio_positive R)) (exponentialRatio_local R)

def exponentialChart_holomorphic (R : QPos) : CertifiedFunctions.Holomorphic (exponentialChart R) :=
  BoundedSeries.seriesMap_holomorphic exponentialCoefficients exponentialCoefficients_valid
    (exponentialBudget (exponentialRatio R)) (exponentialRatio R) R.val
    (exponentialBudget_nonnegative _ (exponentialRatio_positive R))
    (Rat.le_of_lt (exponentialRatio_positive R)) (Rat.le_of_lt R.property)
    (exponentialCoefficients_small _ (exponentialRatio_positive R)) (exponentialRatio_local R)

/-- All charts represent the same exponential wherever both are defined. -/
theorem exponentialChart_agreement (R S : QPos) (z w : Scalar)
    (hz : (exponentialChart R).domain z) (hw : (exponentialChart S).domain w)
    (hzw : z.val.Equiv w.val) :
    ((exponentialChart R).eval z).Equiv ((exponentialChart S).eval w) :=
  BoundedSeries.seriesMap_congr exponentialCoefficients exponentialCoefficients
    exponentialCoefficients_valid exponentialCoefficients_valid
    (fun i => equiv_refl _ (exponentialCoefficients_valid i))
    (exponentialBudget (exponentialRatio R)) (exponentialRatio R) R.val
    (exponentialBudget (exponentialRatio S)) (exponentialRatio S) S.val
    (exponentialBudget_nonnegative _ (exponentialRatio_positive R))
    (Rat.le_of_lt (exponentialRatio_positive R)) (Rat.le_of_lt R.property)
    (exponentialBudget_nonnegative _ (exponentialRatio_positive S))
    (Rat.le_of_lt (exponentialRatio_positive S)) (Rat.le_of_lt S.property)
    (exponentialCoefficients_small _ (exponentialRatio_positive R))
    (exponentialCoefficients_small _ (exponentialRatio_positive S))
    (exponentialRatio_local R) (exponentialRatio_local S) z w hz hw hzw

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

import ComputableAnalysis.PowerSeries
import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.GeneralSeriesHolomorphic

/-! Factorial coefficients admit a geometric majorant with every positive
ratio. This permits holomorphic exponential charts of arbitrarily large radius. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open RationalMajorant ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert

/-- Executable rational coefficient budget for any requested geometric ratio. -/
def exponentialBudget (K : Rat) : Rat := factorialSeriesFiniteBound K⁻¹

theorem exponentialBudget_nonnegative (K : Rat) (hK : 0 < K) :
    0 ≤ exponentialBudget K :=
  factorialSeriesFiniteBound_nonneg (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr hK))

private theorem inverse_power_cancel (K : Rat) (hK : 0 < K) (n : Nat) :
    (K⁻¹)^n*K^n=1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [Rat.pow_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Rat.pow_succ, Rat.pow_succ]
      have hc := Rat.inv_mul_cancel K (Rat.ne_of_gt hK)
      grind

theorem exponential_coefficient_bound (K : Rat) (hK : 0 < K) (n : Nat) :
    1 / factorialRat n ≤ exponentialBudget K * K^n := by
  have hi : 0 ≤ K⁻¹ := Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr hK)
  have hb := factorialTailPartial_le_finiteBound hi n 1
  have ht : factorialTailTerm K⁻¹ n ≤ exponentialBudget K := by
    simpa only [factorialTailPartial, Nat.add_zero, Rat.zero_add, exponentialBudget] using hb
  have hu := inverse_power_cancel K hK n
  have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht (Rat.pow_nonneg (n := n) (Rat.le_of_lt hK))
  have he : factorialTailTerm K⁻¹ n * K^n = 1 / factorialRat n := by
    unfold factorialTailTerm
    rw [Rat.div_def, Rat.div_def]
    grind
  rw [he] at hm
  exact hm

/-- The actual exponential coefficients, embedded as represented complex values. -/
def exponentialCoefficients (n : Nat) : ComplexRaw :=
  ofQComplex ⟨1/factorialRat n,0⟩

theorem exponentialCoefficients_valid (n : Nat) : (exponentialCoefficients n).Valid :=
  ofQComplex_valid _

theorem exponentialCoefficients_small (K : Rat) (hK : 0 < K) (n : Nat) :
    Small (exponentialCoefficients n) (exponentialBudget K*K^n) := by
  have hb := exponential_coefficient_bound K hK n
  have hp : 0 ≤ 1/factorialRat n := by
    rw [Rat.div_def, Rat.one_mul]
    exact Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr (factorialRat_pos n))
  have hr := Rat.mul_nonneg (exponentialBudget_nonnegative K hK) (Rat.pow_nonneg (n := n) (Rat.le_of_lt hK))
  exact ⟨fun _ _ => by change -(exponentialBudget K*K^n) ≤ 1/factorialRat n; grind only,
    fun _ _ => hb, fun _ _ => by change -(exponentialBudget K*K^n) ≤ 0; grind only,
    fun _ _ => hr⟩

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

are separate results; none is assumed in the definition. -/

def nomeSlope : Scalar :=

/-! Holomorphicity of the actual constructed infinite lattice sums. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw RiemannHilbert FunctionTheory DomainFunctions

theorem upperWeightFourLatticeMap_remainder_quadratic
    (a : Scalar) (ha : InUpperHalfPlane a.val) (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val)
    (hs : Small (sub z.val a.val) (upperRadius a ha).val)
    (H : QPos) (hza : Small (sub z.val a.val) H.val) :
    Small (DomainFunctions.remainder upperWeightFourLatticeMap a ha
      ⟨_,derivativeWeightFourSum_valid a ha⟩ z hz) (localWeightFourRemainderConstant a ha*H.val*H.val) := by
  have hd := SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_scale _ (localDerivativeWeightFourTailRate_shrinks a ha)
    (2*H.val) (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) (Rat.le_of_lt H.property))
  have he : (fun n => (2*H.val)*localDerivativeWeightFourTailRate a ha n)=
      (fun n => 2*localDerivativeWeightFourTailRate a ha n*H.val) := by funext n; grind
  rw [he] at hd
  have hv := RepresentedCauchySum.sum_shrinks _ _
    (localWeightFourTailRate_shrinks a ha) (localWeightFourTailRate_shrinks a ha)
  have herror := RepresentedCauchySum.sum_shrinks _ _ hv hd
  exact SeriesLimitLaws.small_of_prefix_bound _ (DomainFunctions.remainder_valid _ _ _ _ _ _)
    (fun n => DomainFunctions.remainder (upperFiniteMap 4 (QuadraticOrder163.squarePoints (n+1))) a ha
      ((upperFiniteMap_holomorphic 4 (QuadraticOrder163.squarePoints (n+1))).derivative a ha) z hz)
    (fun n => DomainFunctions.remainder_valid _ _ _ _ _ _) _ _ herror
    (upperWeightFourLatticeMap_remainder_close_finite a ha z hz hs H hza)
    (fun n => upperFiniteSquare_weightFour_remainder_local_bound a ha z hz hs H.val
      (Rat.le_of_lt H.property) hza (n+1))

def upperWeightFourLatticeMap_hasDerivativeAt (a : Scalar) (ha : InUpperHalfPlane a.val) :
    HasDerivativeAt upperWeightFourLatticeMap a ha ⟨_,derivativeWeightFourSum_valid a ha⟩ where
  delta eps := minRadius (upperRadius a ha)
    (divideRadius eps ⟨localWeightFourRemainderConstant a ha+1, by
      have h := localWeightFourRemainderConstant_nonnegative a ha; grind⟩)
  estimate eps H z hz hH hza := by
    have hs := hza.mono (Rat.le_trans hH (minRadius_left _ _))
    have hb := upperWeightFourLatticeMap_remainder_quadratic a ha z hz hs H hza
    apply hb.mono
    have hC := localWeightFourRemainderConstant_nonnegative a ha
    have hrad := Rat.le_trans hH (minRadius_right _ _)
    have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrad (show 0≤localWeightFourRemainderConstant a ha+1 by grind)
    have he := divideRadius_identity eps
      (⟨localWeightFourRemainderConstant a ha+1, by grind⟩ : QPos)
    rw [he] at hm
    have hp := H.property
    have h1 : localWeightFourRemainderConstant a ha*H.val≤eps.val := by grind
    exact Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Rat.le_of_lt hp)

  openDomain := ⟨upperRadius,upperRadius_inside⟩
  derivative a ha := ⟨derivativeWeightFourSum a ha,derivativeWeightFourSum_valid a ha⟩
  atPoint := upperWeightFourLatticeMap_hasDerivativeAt
  derivative_congr a b ha hb he := derivativeWeightFourSum_congr a b ha hb he
  continuousDerivative := derivativeWeightFourMap_continuous

theorem upperWeightSixLatticeMap_remainder_quadratic
    (a : Scalar) (ha : InUpperHalfPlane a.val) (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val)
    (hs : Small (sub z.val a.val) (upperRadius a ha).val)
    (H : QPos) (hza : Small (sub z.val a.val) H.val) :
    Small (DomainFunctions.remainder upperWeightSixLatticeMap a ha
      ⟨_,derivativeWeightSixSum_valid a ha⟩ z hz) (localWeightSixRemainderConstant a ha*H.val*H.val) := by
  have hd := SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_scale _ (localDerivativeWeightSixTailRate_shrinks a ha)
    (2*H.val) (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) (Rat.le_of_lt H.property))
  have he : (fun n => (2*H.val)*localDerivativeWeightSixTailRate a ha n)=
      (fun n => 2*localDerivativeWeightSixTailRate a ha n*H.val) := by funext n; grind
  rw [he] at hd
  have hv := RepresentedCauchySum.sum_shrinks _ _
    (localWeightSixTailRate_shrinks a ha) (localWeightSixTailRate_shrinks a ha)
  have herror := RepresentedCauchySum.sum_shrinks _ _ hv hd
  exact SeriesLimitLaws.small_of_prefix_bound _ (DomainFunctions.remainder_valid _ _ _ _ _ _)
    (fun n => DomainFunctions.remainder (upperFiniteMap 6 (QuadraticOrder163.squarePoints (n+1))) a ha
      ((upperFiniteMap_holomorphic 6 (QuadraticOrder163.squarePoints (n+1))).derivative a ha) z hz)
    (fun n => DomainFunctions.remainder_valid _ _ _ _ _ _) _ _ herror
    (upperWeightSixLatticeMap_remainder_close_finite a ha z hz hs H hza)
    (fun n => upperFiniteSquare_weightSix_remainder_local_bound a ha z hz hs H.val
      (Rat.le_of_lt H.property) hza (n+1))

def upperWeightSixLatticeMap_hasDerivativeAt (a : Scalar) (ha : InUpperHalfPlane a.val) :
    HasDerivativeAt upperWeightSixLatticeMap a ha ⟨_,derivativeWeightSixSum_valid a ha⟩ where
  delta eps := minRadius (upperRadius a ha)
    (divideRadius eps ⟨localWeightSixRemainderConstant a ha+1, by
      have h := localWeightSixRemainderConstant_nonnegative a ha; grind⟩)
  estimate eps H z hz hH hza := by
    have hs := hza.mono (Rat.le_trans hH (minRadius_left _ _))
    have hb := upperWeightSixLatticeMap_remainder_quadratic a ha z hz hs H hza
    apply hb.mono
    have hC := localWeightSixRemainderConstant_nonnegative a ha
    have hrad := Rat.le_trans hH (minRadius_right _ _)
    have hm := Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrad (show 0≤localWeightSixRemainderConstant a ha+1 by grind)
    have he := divideRadius_identity eps
      (⟨localWeightSixRemainderConstant a ha+1, by grind⟩ : QPos)
    rw [he] at hm
    have hp := H.property
    have h1 : localWeightSixRemainderConstant a ha*H.val≤eps.val := by grind
    exact Rat.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Rat.le_of_lt hp)

def upperWeightSixLatticeMap_holomorphic : Holomorphic upperWeightSixLatticeMap where
  openDomain := ⟨upperRadius,upperRadius_inside⟩
  derivative a ha := ⟨derivativeWeightSixSum a ha,derivativeWeightSixSum_valid a ha⟩
  atPoint := upperWeightSixLatticeMap_hasDerivativeAt
  derivative_congr a b ha hb he := derivativeWeightSixSum_congr a b ha hb he
  continuousDerivative := derivativeWeightSixMap_continuous

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

/-! Infinite modular weight identities for the constructed lattice sums. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open RiemannHilbert FunctionTheory QuadraticOrder163 ComplexRaw LocalODE

private theorem index_ge (g : SL2Z) (n : Nat) : n≤basisPrefixIndex g n := by
  have hp : 1≤basisComparisonFactor g := by unfold basisComparisonFactor; omega
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (n+1) hp
  unfold basisPrefixIndex
  omega

private theorem index_shrinks (g : SL2Z) (e : Nat → Rat) (he : ShrinksToZero e) :
    ShrinksToZero (fun n => e (basisPrefixIndex g n)) := by
  intro eps
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := he eps
  exact ⟨N,fun n hn => hN _ (Nat.le_trans hn (index_ge g n))⟩

private theorem rateFour_nonnegative (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (n : Nat) :
    0≤upperWeightFourTailRate z hz n := by
  unfold upperWeightFourTailRate upperWeightFourTailConstant reciprocalSquare
  have hp : 0<((n+1:Nat):Rat) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<n+1 by omega)
  exact Rat.mul_nonneg
    (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) (Rat.pow_nonneg
      (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) (latticeReciprocalConstant_nonnegative z hz))))
    (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr (Rat.mul_pos hp hp)))

theorem upperWeightFourLatticeSum_action (g : SL2Z) (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) :
    (upperWeightFourLatticeSum (fractionalLinear g z hz) (fractionalLinear_mem g z hz)).Equiv
      (mul (power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 4) (upperWeightFourLatticeSum z hz)) := by
  let w := fractionalLinear g z hz
  let hw := fractionalLinear_mem g z hz
  let h := latticeIndexMatrix g
  let c := power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 4
  have hc : c.Valid := power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 4
  let M := boxCoordinateBound (c.compute 0)
  have hM : 0≤M := boxCoordinateBound_nonneg _
  have hcM : Small c M := small_from_box c hc 0
  let p := fun n => upperWeightFourPrefix w hw (basisPrefixIndex h n)
  have hp : ∀ n, (p n).Valid := fun n => upperWeightFourPrefix_valid w hw _
  let e := fun n => upperWeightFourTailRate w hw (basisPrefixIndex h n)
  let f := fun n => (2*M)*upperBasisWeightFourError z hz h n
  have he : ShrinksToZero e := index_shrinks h _ (upperWeightFourTailRate_shrinks w hw)
  have hf : ShrinksToZero f := SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_scale _
    (upperBasisWeightFourError_shrinks z hz h) (2*M) (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) hM)
  have he0 (n : Nat) : 0≤e n := rateFour_nonnegative w hw _
  have hE0 (n : Nat) : 0≤upperBasisWeightFourError z hz h n :=
    Rat.add_nonneg (rateFour_nonnegative z hz _) (Rat.add_nonneg
      (rateFour_nonnegative z hz n) (rateFour_nonnegative z hz n))
  have hf0 (n : Nat) : 0≤f n := Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) hM) (hE0 n)
  apply RepresentedCauchySum.unique p hp (fun n => e n+f n)
    (RepresentedCauchySum.sum_shrinks e f he hf) _ _
    (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid w hw) (mul_valid hc (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz))
  · intro n
    exact (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_close_prefix w hw (basisPrefixIndex h n)).mono (by
      have hh := hf0 n
      change e n≤e n+f n
      grind only)
  · intro n
    have hb := representedFactor_difference_small c (upperWeightFourLatticeSum z hz)
      (upperBasisReindexedPrefix z hz h 4 n) hc (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz)
      (upperBasisReindexedPrefix_valid z hz h 4 n) M (upperBasisWeightFourError z hz h n)
      hM (hE0 n) hcM (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_close_reindexed z hz h n)
    have ht := Small.congr
      (sub_valid (mul_valid hc (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz))
        (mul_valid hc (upperBasisReindexedPrefix_valid z hz h 4 n)))
      (sub_valid (mul_valid hc (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz)) (hp n))
      (FunctionTheory.sub_congr (equiv_refl _ (mul_valid hc (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz)))
        (equiv_symm (upperWeightFourPrefix_action g z hz n))) hb
    exact ht.mono (by
      have hh := he0 n
      change f n≤e n+f n
      grind only)

private theorem rateSix_nonnegative (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (n : Nat) :
    0≤upperWeightSixTailRate z hz n := by
  unfold upperWeightSixTailRate upperWeightSixTailConstant reciprocalSquare
  have hp : 0<((n+1:Nat):Rat) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<n+1 by omega)
  exact Rat.mul_nonneg
    (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) (Rat.pow_nonneg
      (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) (latticeReciprocalConstant_nonnegative z hz))))
    (Rat.le_of_lt (Rat.inv_pos.mpr (Rat.mul_pos hp hp)))

theorem upperWeightSixLatticeSum_action (g : SL2Z) (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) :
    (upperWeightSixLatticeSum (fractionalLinear g z hz) (fractionalLinear_mem g z hz)).Equiv
      (mul (power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 6) (upperWeightSixLatticeSum z hz)) := by
  let w := fractionalLinear g z hz
  let hw := fractionalLinear_mem g z hz
  let h := latticeIndexMatrix g
  let c := power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 6
  have hc : c.Valid := power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 6
  let M := boxCoordinateBound (c.compute 0)
  have hM : 0≤M := boxCoordinateBound_nonneg _
  have hcM : Small c M := small_from_box c hc 0
  let p := fun n => upperWeightSixPrefix w hw (basisPrefixIndex h n)
  have hp : ∀ n, (p n).Valid := fun n => upperWeightSixPrefix_valid w hw _
  let e := fun n => upperWeightSixTailRate w hw (basisPrefixIndex h n)
  let f := fun n => (2*M)*upperBasisWeightSixError z hz h n
  have he : ShrinksToZero e := index_shrinks h _ (upperWeightSixTailRate_shrinks w hw)
  have hf : ShrinksToZero f := SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_scale _
    (upperBasisWeightSixError_shrinks z hz h) (2*M) (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) hM)
  have he0 (n : Nat) : 0≤e n := rateSix_nonnegative w hw _
  have hE0 (n : Nat) : 0≤upperBasisWeightSixError z hz h n :=
    Rat.add_nonneg (rateSix_nonnegative z hz _) (Rat.add_nonneg
      (rateSix_nonnegative z hz n) (rateSix_nonnegative z hz n))
  have hf0 (n : Nat) : 0≤f n := Rat.mul_nonneg (Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide) hM) (hE0 n)
  apply RepresentedCauchySum.unique p hp (fun n => e n+f n)
    (RepresentedCauchySum.sum_shrinks e f he hf) _ _
    (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid w hw) (mul_valid hc (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid z hz))
  · intro n
    exact (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_close_prefix w hw (basisPrefixIndex h n)).mono (by
      have hh := hf0 n
      change e n≤e n+f n
      grind only)
  · intro n
    have hb := representedFactor_difference_small c (upperWeightSixLatticeSum z hz)
      (upperBasisReindexedPrefix z hz h 6 n) hc (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid z hz)
      (upperBasisReindexedPrefix_valid z hz h 6 n) M (upperBasisWeightSixError z hz h n)
      hM (hE0 n) hcM (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_close_reindexed z hz h n)
    have ht := Small.congr
      (sub_valid (mul_valid hc (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid z hz))
        (mul_valid hc (upperBasisReindexedPrefix_valid z hz h 6 n)))
      (sub_valid (mul_valid hc (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid z hz)) (hp n))
      (FunctionTheory.sub_congr (equiv_refl _ (mul_valid hc (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid z hz)))
        (equiv_symm (upperWeightSixPrefix_action g z hz n))) hb
    exact ht.mono (by
      have hh := he0 n
      change f n≤e n+f n
      grind only)

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.UpperLatticeHolomorphic

/-! The actual holomorphic lattice discriminant expression. Cusp normalization
and nonvanishing are separate theorems, not assumed here. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw RiemannHilbert FunctionTheory DomainFunctions

private def constantUpper (c : Rat) : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  constantOn (fun z => InUpperHalfPlane z.val) upperOpenData.invariant
    ⟨ofQComplex ⟨c,0⟩,ofQComplex_valid _⟩

private def constantUpper_holomorphic (c : Rat) : Holomorphic (constantUpper c) :=
  constantOn_holomorphic upperOpenData ⟨ofQComplex ⟨c,0⟩,ofQComplex_valid _⟩

def latticeG2Map : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  productOn (constantUpper 60) upperWeightFourLatticeMap (fun _ hz => hz)

def latticeG3Map : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  productOn (constantUpper 140) upperWeightSixLatticeMap (fun _ hz => hz)

def latticeG2Map_holomorphic : Holomorphic latticeG2Map :=
  (constantUpper_holomorphic 60).productOn upperWeightFourLatticeMap_holomorphic (fun _ hz => hz)

def latticeG3Map_holomorphic : Holomorphic latticeG3Map :=
  (constantUpper_holomorphic 140).productOn upperWeightSixLatticeMap_holomorphic (fun _ hz => hz)

def latticeG2CubeMap : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  productOn (productOn latticeG2Map latticeG2Map (fun _ hz => hz)) latticeG2Map (fun _ hz => hz)

def latticeG3SquareMap : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  productOn latticeG3Map latticeG3Map (fun _ hz => hz)

def latticeG2CubeMap_holomorphic : Holomorphic latticeG2CubeMap :=
  (latticeG2Map_holomorphic.productOn latticeG2Map_holomorphic (fun _ hz => hz)).productOn
    latticeG2Map_holomorphic (fun _ hz => hz)

def latticeG3SquareMap_holomorphic : Holomorphic latticeG3SquareMap :=
  latticeG3Map_holomorphic.productOn latticeG3Map_holomorphic (fun _ hz => hz)

def latticeDiscriminantMap : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  sumOn latticeG2CubeMap (DomainFunctions.negate
    (productOn (constantUpper 27) latticeG3SquareMap (fun _ hz => hz))) (fun _ hz => hz)

def latticeDiscriminantMap_holomorphic : Holomorphic latticeDiscriminantMap :=
  latticeG2CubeMap_holomorphic.sumOn
    (((constantUpper_holomorphic 27).productOn latticeG3SquareMap_holomorphic (fun _ hz => hz)).negate)
    (fun _ hz => hz)

theorem latticeDiscriminantMap_action (g : SL2Z) (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) :
    (latticeDiscriminantMap.eval (fractionalLinear g z hz) (fractionalLinear_mem g z hz)).val.Equiv
      (mul (LocalODE.power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 12) (latticeDiscriminantMap.eval z hz).val) := by
  let w := fractionalLinear g z hz
  let hw := fractionalLinear_mem g z hz
  let V4 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (upperWeightFourLatticeSum z hz) (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz)
  let V6 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (upperWeightSixLatticeSum z hz) (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid z hz)
  let W4 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (upperWeightFourLatticeSum w hw) (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid w hw)
  let W6 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (upperWeightSixLatticeSum w hw) (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid w hw)
  let F := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property)
  have h4 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
    (hleft := upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid w hw)
    (hright := mul_valid (LocalODE.power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 4)
      (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz)) (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_action g z hz)
  have h6 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
    (hleft := upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid w hw)
    (hright := mul_valid (LocalODE.power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 6)
      (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid z hz)) (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_action g z hz)
  change W4=ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (LocalODE.power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 4)
    (LocalODE.power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 4)*V4 at h4
  change W6=ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (LocalODE.power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 6)
    (LocalODE.power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 6)*V6 at h6
  rw [ScalarAlgebra.ofRaw_power] at h4 h6
  apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
    (hleft := (latticeDiscriminantMap.eval w hw).property)
    (hright := mul_valid (LocalODE.power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 12)
      (latticeDiscriminantMap.eval z hz).property)
  let C60 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofQComplex ⟨60,0⟩
  let C140 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofQComplex ⟨140,0⟩
  let C27 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofQComplex ⟨27,0⟩
  change ((C60*W4)*(C60*W4))*(C60*W4) + -(C27*((C140*W6)*(C140*W6))) =
    ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (LocalODE.power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 12)
      (LocalODE.power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 12)*
    (((C60*V4)*(C60*V4))*(C60*V4) + -(C27*((C140*V6)*(C140*V6))))
  rw [ScalarAlgebra.ofRaw_power]
  change ((C60*W4)*(C60*W4))*(C60*W4) + -(C27*((C140*W6)*(C140*W6))) =
    F^12*(((C60*V4)*(C60*V4))*(C60*V4) + -(C27*((C140*V6)*(C140*V6))))
  change W4=F^4*V4 at h4
  change W6=F^6*V6 at h6
  rw [h4,h6]
  grind only

theorem latticeG2CubeMap_action (g : SL2Z) (z : Scalar) (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) :
    (latticeG2CubeMap.eval (fractionalLinear g z hz) (fractionalLinear_mem g z hz)).val.Equiv
      (mul (LocalODE.power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 12) (latticeG2CubeMap.eval z hz).val) := by
  let w := fractionalLinear g z hz
  let hw := fractionalLinear_mem g z hz
  let V4 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (upperWeightFourLatticeSum z hz) (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz)
  let V6 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (upperWeightSixLatticeSum z hz) (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid z hz)
  let W4 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (upperWeightFourLatticeSum w hw) (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid w hw)
  let W6 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (upperWeightSixLatticeSum w hw) (upperWeightSixLatticeSum_valid w hw)
  let F := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property)
  have h4 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
    (hleft := upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid w hw)
    (hright := mul_valid (LocalODE.power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 4)
      (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_valid z hz)) (upperWeightFourLatticeSum_action g z hz)
  change W4=ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (LocalODE.power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 4)
    (LocalODE.power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 4)*V4 at h4
  rw [ScalarAlgebra.ofRaw_power] at h4
  apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
    (hleft := (latticeG2CubeMap.eval w hw).property)
    (hright := mul_valid (LocalODE.power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 12)
      (latticeG2CubeMap.eval z hz).property)
  let C60 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofQComplex ⟨60,0⟩
  let C140 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofQComplex ⟨140,0⟩
  let C27 := ComplexRawQuotient.ofQComplex ⟨27,0⟩
  change ((C60*W4)*(C60*W4))*(C60*W4) =
    ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (LocalODE.power (integerAffine g.c g.d z.val) 12)
      (LocalODE.power_valid _ (integerAffine_valid _ _ z.property) 12)*
    (((C60*V4)*(C60*V4))*(C60*V4))
  rw [ScalarAlgebra.ofRaw_power]
  change ((C60*W4)*(C60*W4))*(C60*W4) = F^12*(((C60*V4)*(C60*V4))*(C60*V4))
  change W4=F^4*V4 at h4
  rw [h4]
  grind only

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.NomeDiscriminantHolomorphic
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw RiemannHilbert FunctionTheory DomainFunctions
private def normalizationMap : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  constantOn tauEulerNomeDomain tauEulerNomeDomain_openData.invariant
    ⟨scaleRat (1/1728) one,scaleRat_valid (ofQComplex_valid _)⟩
private def normalizationMap_holomorphic : Holomorphic normalizationMap :=
  constantOn_holomorphic tauEulerNomeDomain_openData
    ⟨scaleRat (1/1728) one,scaleRat_valid (ofQComplex_valid _)⟩
/-- The actual normalized Eisenstein discriminant on the nome domain. -/
def nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  productOn normalizationMap nomeDiscriminantNumeratorMap (fun _ h => h)
noncomputable def nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap_holomorphic : Holomorphic nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap :=
  normalizationMap_holomorphic.productOn nomeDiscriminantNumeratorMap_holomorphic (fun _ h => h)
theorem nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap_eval (q : Scalar) (hq : tauEulerNomeDomain q) :
    (nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap.eval q hq).val.Equiv
      (scaleRat (1/1728) (nomeDiscriminantNumeratorMap.eval q hq).val) := by
  let N := nomeDiscriminantNumeratorMap.eval q hq
  apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
    (hleft := (nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap.eval q hq).property)
    (hright := scaleRat_valid N.property)
  let n := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw N.val N.property
  change ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (1/1728) 1*n=ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (1/1728) n
  rw [←ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat_mul]
  congr 1
  grind only
/-- The normalized discriminant satisfies the exact theta equation. -/
theorem nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap_theta (q : Scalar) (hq : tauEulerNomeDomain q) :
    (mul q.val (nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap_holomorphic.derivative q hq).val).Equiv
      (mul (tauWeightTwoNomeMap.eval q hq).val (nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap.eval q hq).val) := by
  let N := nomeDiscriminantNumeratorMap.eval q hq
  let D := nomeDiscriminantNumeratorMap_holomorphic.derivative q hq
  let E := tauWeightTwoNomeMap.eval q hq
  have hh := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
    (hleft := mul_valid q.property D.property) (hright := mul_valid E.property N.property)
    (nomeDiscriminantNumeratorMap_theta_unscaled q hq)
  apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
    (hleft := mul_valid q.property (nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap_holomorphic.derivative q hq).property)
    (hright := mul_valid E.property (nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap.eval q hq).property)
  let n := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw N.val N.property
  let d := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw D.val D.property
  let e := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw E.val E.property
  let z := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw q.val q.property
  change z*d=e*n at hh
  change z*(0*n+ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (1/1728) 1*d)=
    e*(ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (1/1728) 1*n)
  grind only
end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.LatticeDiscriminant
import ComputableAnalysis.RiemannHilbert.ReciprocalHolomorphic

/-! The actual lattice j evaluator on its justified nonzero-discriminant domain. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw RiemannHilbert FunctionTheory DomainFunctions

def latticeDiscriminantReciprocalMap : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  compose ReciprocalHolomorphic.function latticeDiscriminantMap

def latticeDiscriminantReciprocalMap_holomorphic : Holomorphic latticeDiscriminantReciprocalMap :=
  ReciprocalHolomorphic.holomorphic.compose latticeDiscriminantMap_holomorphic

private def latticeJNumeratorMap : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  productOn (constantOn (fun z => InUpperHalfPlane z.val) upperOpenData.invariant
    ⟨ofQComplex ⟨1728,0⟩,ofQComplex_valid _⟩) latticeG2CubeMap (fun _ hz => hz)

private def latticeJNumeratorMap_holomorphic : Holomorphic latticeJNumeratorMap :=
  (constantOn_holomorphic upperOpenData ⟨ofQComplex ⟨1728,0⟩,ofQComplex_valid _⟩).productOn
    latticeG2CubeMap_holomorphic (fun _ hz => hz)

def latticeJMap : DomainFunctions.Map :=
  productOn latticeDiscriminantReciprocalMap latticeJNumeratorMap (fun _ hz => hz.1)

def latticeJMap_holomorphic : Holomorphic latticeJMap :=
  latticeDiscriminantReciprocalMap_holomorphic.productOn latticeJNumeratorMap_holomorphic
    (fun _ hz => hz.1)

theorem latticeJMap_domain (z : Scalar) : latticeJMap.domain z ↔
    ∃ hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val, NonzeroBoxSearch.Nonzero (latticeDiscriminantMap.eval z hz) := by
  constructor
  · intro hz; exact ⟨hz.1,hz.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hz,hn⟩; exact ⟨hz,hn⟩

theorem latticeJMap_discriminant_product (z : Scalar) (hz : latticeJMap.domain z) :
    (mul (latticeJMap.eval z hz).val (latticeDiscriminantMap.eval z hz.1).val).Equiv
      (mul (ofQComplex ⟨1728,0⟩) (latticeG2CubeMap.eval z hz.1).val) := by
  have hi := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
    (hleft := mul_valid (latticeDiscriminantMap.eval z hz.1).property
      (RepresentedReciprocal.inverse (latticeDiscriminantMap.eval z hz.1) hz.2).property)
    (hright := ofQComplex_valid _)

import ComputableAnalysis.Basic

/-!
# Formal discriminant coefficients

Integer coefficients of the finite products defining the discriminant.
No analytic convergence or modular transformation law is asserted here.
-/

namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

/-- A formal integer coefficient sequence; no convergence is implicit. -/
abbrev Coefficients := Nat → Int

/-- Multiplication by the polynomial `1 - q^m`. -/
def subtractShift (m : Nat) (a : Coefficients) : Coefficients :=
  fun n => if m ≤ n then a n - a (n - m) else a n

/-- Multiplication by `(1 - q^m)^r` by finite recursion. -/
def factorPower (m : Nat) : Nat → Coefficients → Coefficients
  | 0, a => a
  | r + 1, a => subtractShift m (factorPower m r a)

/-- The constant polynomial one. -/
def unitCoefficients : Coefficients := fun n => if n = 0 then 1 else 0

/-- Coefficients of the product of the first `N` factors, each to power 24. -/
def discriminantProduct : Nat → Coefficients
  | 0 => unitCoefficients
  | N + 1 => factorPower (N + 1) 24 (discriminantProduct N)

/-- The coefficient of `q^n` in `q ∏ (1-q^m)^24`; the zero coefficient is zero. -/
def tau : Nat → Int
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => discriminantProduct n n

theorem factorPower_below (m r n : Nat) (a : Coefficients) (h : n < m) :
    factorPower m r a n = a n := by
  induction r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r ih =>
      simp [factorPower, subtractShift, Nat.not_le.mpr h, ih]

/-- Factors of degree above the queried coefficient cannot change it. -/
theorem discriminantProduct_stable (n N : Nat) (h : n ≤ N) :
    discriminantProduct N n = discriminantProduct n n := by
  induction N with
  | zero =>
      have hn : n = 0 := by omega
      subst n
      rfl
  | succ N ih =>
      by_cases hn : n ≤ N
      · rw [discriminantProduct, factorPower_below (N + 1) 24 n _ (by omega)]
        exact ih hn
      · have he : n = N + 1 := by omega
        subst n
        rfl

/-- The infinite formal product has an exact finite computation at each degree. -/
theorem tau_eq_finiteProduct (n N : Nat) (h : n ≤ N) :
    tau (n + 1) = discriminantProduct N n := by
  exact (discriminantProduct_stable n N h).symm

@[simp] theorem tau_zero : tau 0 = 0 := rfl
@[simp] theorem tau_one : tau 1 = 1 := rfl

theorem product_constant (N : Nat) : discriminantProduct N 0 = 1 := by
  exact discriminantProduct_stable 0 N (Nat.zero_le N)

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.HeckeCoefficientHolomorphicSeries
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.TauDiscriminantSeriesPrefix

namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw FunctionTheory RiemannHilbert DomainFunctions

def tauComplexCoefficient (n : Nat) : ComplexRaw := scaleRat (tau n : Rat) one

theorem tauComplexCoefficient_valid (n : Nat) : (tauComplexCoefficient n).Valid :=
  scaleRat_valid (ofQComplex_valid _)

theorem tauComplexCoefficient_bound (n : Nat) : Small (tauComplexCoefficient n) (2*(256:Rat)^n) := by
  have ho : Small one 1 := by
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro k l; change (-1:Rat)≤1; decide +kernel
    · intro k l; change (1:Rat)≤1; decide +kernel
    · intro k l; change (-1:Rat)≤0; decide +kernel
    · intro k l; change (0:Rat)≤1; decide +kernel
  have hs := small_scale_integer one (ofQComplex_valid _) 1 ho (tau n)
  rw [Rat.mul_one] at hs
  exact hs.mono (tau_absolute_exponential_bound n)

/-- Ordinary integer prefixes are literal bounded-series prefixes. -/
theorem integerCoefficientPrefix_boundedSeries (a : Nat → Int) (q : Scalar) (N : Nat) :
    (BoundedSeries.valueBlock (fun n => scaleRat (a n : Rat) one) q.val 0 N).Equiv
      (integerCoefficientPrefix a q N).val := by
  induction N with
  | zero => exact equiv_refl _ (ofQComplex_valid _)
  | succ N ih =>
    have hp := LocalODE.power_valid _ q.property N
    have ht : (mul (scaleRat (a N:Rat) one) (LocalODE.power q.val N)).Equiv
        (scaleRat (a N:Rat) (LocalODE.power q.val N)) := by
      apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
        (hleft := mul_valid (scaleRat_valid (ofQComplex_valid _)) hp)
        (hright := scaleRat_valid hp)
      change ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (a N:Rat) 1*
        ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (LocalODE.power q.val N) hp=
        ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (a N:Rat) (ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (LocalODE.power q.val N) hp)
      rw [←ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat_mul]
      congr 1
      grind only
    simp only [BoundedSeries.valueBlock,Nat.zero_add,integerCoefficientPrefix]
    exact add_equiv ih ht

/-- The bounded sum with literal full tau coefficients agrees with the
actual normalized discriminant throughout the supplied small nome disk. -/
theorem tauBoundedSeries_nome_discriminant_agreement (q : Scalar)
    (hq : tauEulerNomeDomain q) (hs : Small q.val (1/2048)) :
    (BoundedSeries.sumValue tauComplexCoefficient q.val tauComplexCoefficient_valid q.property
      2 256 (1/2048)).Equiv (nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap.eval q hq).val := by
  let F := BoundedSeries.sumValue tauComplexCoefficient q.val tauComplexCoefficient_valid q.property
    2 256 (1/2048)
  let G := mul (tauSeriesValue q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ q hq)).val q.val
  have hF : F.Valid := BoundedSeries.sumValue_valid _ _ tauComplexCoefficient_valid q.property
    2 256 (1/2048) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)
    tauComplexCoefficient_bound hs (by decide +kernel)
  have hG : G.Valid := mul_valid (tauSeriesValue q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ q hq)).property q.property
  let E := fun N => LocalODE.valueTail 2 256 (1/2048) (N+1)
  have hE : ShrinksToZero E := SeriesLimitLaws.shrinks_shift _
    (LocalODE.tail_bound_shrinks 2 (2*256*(1/2048)) (by decide +kernel)
      (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)) 1
  have hEn (N : Nat) : 0≤E N := Rat.mul_nonneg (by decide +kernel) (Rat.pow_nonneg (by decide +kernel))
  have he : F.Equiv G := by
    apply RepresentedCauchySum.unique
      (fun N => (integerCoefficientPrefix tau q (N+1)).val)
      (fun N => (integerCoefficientPrefix tau q (N+1)).property)
      (fun N => E N+tauDiscriminantPrefixError N)
      (RepresentedCauchySum.sum_shrinks _ _ hE tauDiscriminantPrefixError_shrinks) F G hF hG
    · intro N
      have hb := BoundedSeries.sumValue_close_prefix tauComplexCoefficient q.val
        tauComplexCoefficient_valid q.property 2 256 (1/2048)
        (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)
        tauComplexCoefficient_bound hs (by decide +kernel) (N+1)
      have ht := Small.congr
        (sub_valid hF (BoundedSeries.valueBlock_valid _ _ tauComplexCoefficient_valid q.property 0 (N+1)))
        (sub_valid hF (integerCoefficientPrefix tau q (N+1)).property)
        (FunctionTheory.sub_congr (equiv_refl _ hF)
          (integerCoefficientPrefix_boundedSeries tau q (N+1))) hb
      exact ht.mono (by have h := tauDiscriminantPrefixError_nonnegative N; change E N≤_; grind only)
    · intro N
      exact (tauDiscriminantSeries_close_prefix q (LocalODE.interior_bound _ q hq) N).mono
        (by have h := hEn N; grind only)
  exact equiv_trans hF hG (nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap.eval q hq).property he
    (equiv_symm (nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap_tau_series q hq))

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

/-- Coefficient extraction from the proved actual modular eigenform identity. -/
theorem discriminantPrimeHecke_coefficients_eigenvector (p : Nat) (hp : BasicPrime p)
    (hpR : 0<(p:Rat)) (n : Nat) :
    discriminantHeckeCoefficients p n=tau p*tau n := by
  let C := heckeCoefficientGrowthConstant p
  let K := heckeCoefficientGrowthBase p
  let R := heckeCoefficientSeriesRadius p
  let M : Rat := ((tau p).natAbs:Rat)
  let c : Nat → Scalar := fun n => ⟨heckeComplexCoefficient p n,heckeComplexCoefficient_valid p n⟩
  let d : Nat → Scalar := fun n => ⟨scaleRat (tau p:Rat) (tauComplexCoefficient n),
    scaleRat_valid (tauComplexCoefficient_valid n)⟩
  let rho : QPos := ⟨(heckeDifferenceNomeRadius p).val/2,
    Rat.mul_pos (heckeDifferenceNomeRadius p).property (by decide +kernel)⟩
  have hC := heckeCoefficientGrowthConstant_nonnegative p
  have hK := Rat.le_of_lt (heckeCoefficientGrowthBase_positive p)
  have hR := Rat.le_of_lt (heckeCoefficientSeriesRadius_positive p)
  have hM : 0≤M := Rat.natCast_nonneg
  have hd (j : Nat) : Small (d j).val ((M*2)*(256:Rat)^j) := by
    have h := small_scale_integer (tauComplexCoefficient j) (tauComplexCoefficient_valid j)
      (2*(256:Rat)^j) (tauComplexCoefficient_bound j) (tau p)
    simpa only [Rat.mul_assoc] using h
  have hl : 2*K*R≤(1:Rat)/2 := by
    have h := heckeCoefficientSeriesRadius_local p
    have hKR := Rat.mul_nonneg hK hR
    dsimp [K,R] at *
    grind only
  have hrho : rho.val<(heckeDifferenceNomeRadius p).val := by
    have h := (heckeDifferenceNomeRadius p).property
    dsimp [rho]
    grind only
  have hcommon := QPos.minimum_le_left (heckeCuspExtensionRadius p) ⟨1/2048,by decide +kernel⟩
  have hsmall := QPos.minimum_le_right (heckeCuspExtensionRadius p) ⟨1/2048,by decide +kernel⟩
  have hrR : rho.val≤R := by
    have h := heckeCuspExtensionRadius_series p
    change (heckeDifferenceNomeRadius p).val≤(heckeCuspExtensionRadius p).val at hcommon
    dsimp [R]
    grind only
  have hrS : rho.val≤(1:Rat)/2048 := by
    change (heckeDifferenceNomeRadius p).val≤(1:Rat)/2048 at hsmall
    grind only
  have he := boundedSeries_coefficients_unique c d C K R (M*2) 256 (1/2048)
    hC hK hR (Rat.mul_nonneg hM (by decide +kernel)) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)
    (heckeComplexCoefficient_bound p) hd hl (by decide +kernel) rho hrR hrS
    (by
      intro r hr
      let q := realStep r
      have hqr : r.val<(heckeDifferenceNomeRadius p).val := by grind only
      have hq : heckeDifferenceNomeDomain p q :=
        ⟨r.val,Rat.le_of_lt r.property,hqr,realStep_small r⟩
      have hqs : Small q.val (1/2048) := (realStep_small r).mono (Rat.le_trans hr hrS)
      let H := (heckeCoefficientSeriesMap p).eval q
      let T := BoundedSeries.sumValue tauComplexCoefficient q.val tauComplexCoefficient_valid q.property 2 256 (1/2048)
      let ht := heckeDifferenceNomeDomain_tau p q hq
      let D := nomeNormalizedDiscriminantMap.eval q ht
      have hD := tauBoundedSeries_nome_discriminant_agreement q ht hqs
      have hT := BoundedSeries.sumValue_valid tauComplexCoefficient q.val tauComplexCoefficient_valid q.property
        2 256 (1/2048) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)
        tauComplexCoefficient_bound hqs (by decide +kernel)
      have hH := (heckeCoefficientSeriesMap p).valid q (heckeDifferenceNomeDomain_series p q hq)
      have hzero := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
        (hleft := ((discriminantPrimeHeckeDifferenceNome p).eval q hq).property)
        (hright := ofQComplex_valid _) (discriminantPrimeHeckeDifferenceNome_global_zero p hp hpR q hq)
      have hactual : H.Equiv (scaleRat (tau p:Rat) D.val) := by
        let A := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw H hH
        let B := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw D.val D.property
        change A+ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (-(tau p:Rat)) 1*B=0 at hzero
        rw [←ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat_mul] at hzero
        have hone : (1:ScalarAlgebra.Value)*B=B := by grind only
        rw [hone,←ComplexRawQuotient.neg_scaleRat] at hzero
        apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq (hleft := hH) (hright := scaleRat_valid D.property)
        change A=ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (tau p:Rat) B
        grind only
      have hscaled := boundedSeries_integer_scaling tauComplexCoefficient tauComplexCoefficient_valid q (tau p)
        2 256 (1/2048) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel)
        tauComplexCoefficient_bound hqs (by decide +kernel)
      have hweighted := scaleRat_equiv (r := (tau p:Rat)) (equiv_symm hD)
      have hleft := equiv_trans hH (scaleRat_valid D.property) (scaleRat_valid hT) hactual hweighted
      exact equiv_trans hH (scaleRat_valid hT)
        (BoundedSeries.sumValue_valid _ _ (fun j => (d j).property) q.property (M*2) 256 (1/2048)
          (Rat.mul_nonneg hM (by decide +kernel)) (by decide +kernel) (by decide +kernel) hd hqs (by decide +kernel))
        hleft (equiv_symm hscaled)) n
  have hprod := ComplexRaw.scaleRat_scaleRat_equiv (tau p:Rat) (tau n:Rat) one (ofQComplex_valid _)
  have heq := equiv_trans (c n).property (d n).property (scaleRat_valid (ofQComplex_valid _)) he hprod
  have hreal := (RealRaw.compareAt_overlap_iff _ _ 0 0).1 (realPart_equiv heq 0)
  have hrat : (discriminantHeckeCoefficients p n:Rat)=(tau p:Rat)*(tau n:Rat) := by
    dsimp [c,heckeComplexCoefficient,realPart,scaleRat,one,ofQComplex,QBox.scaleRat,
      QComplex.scaleRat,QComplex.one,QInterval.Overlaps] at hreal
    split at hreal <;> split at hreal <;> grind only
  exact_mod_cast hrat

/-- The literal tau coefficients satisfy every prime-index Hecke equation. -/
theorem tau_prime_hecke_eigenvector (p : Nat) (hp : BasicPrime p) :
    IsHeckeEigenvector p tau (tau p) := by
  have hpR : 0<(p:Rat) := Rat.natCast_pos.mpr (by have h := hp.1; omega)
  intro n
  have h := discriminantPrimeHecke_coefficients_eigenvector p hp hpR n
  simp only [hecke12,discriminantHeckeCoefficients,heckeDilationCoefficients,Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero] at h ⊢
  by_cases hn : n%p=0 <;> simpa only [hn,ite_true,ite_false,Int.mul_zero] using h

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

/-- Integer first-argument coefficients for each second-argument degree. -/
def integerHeckeIntegerRow41 (i : Fin 43) : List Int :=
  if i.val=42 then [1] else
    integerPrincipalPartPolynomialList (integerHeckePrincipalCutoff41 (41-i.val))
      (integerHeckePrincipalPolynomialCoefficients41 (41-i.val))
      (integerHeckePrincipalCutoff41 (41-i.val)+1)

/-- The integer diagonal polynomial, built by finite addition and shifts.
Its coefficients are independent of every represented analytic argument. -/
def integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41 : List Int :=
  integerPolynomialDiagonal (List.ofFn integerHeckeIntegerRow41)

private theorem one_eval (J : Scalar) :
    (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding [1]) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).raw.Equiv one := by
  apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
    (hleft := (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding [1]) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).valid)
    (hright := ofQComplex_valid QComplex.one)
  change RepresentedPolynomial.certClass (RepresentedPolynomial.eval
    (integerPolynomialEmbedding [1]) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩)=1
  rw [integerPolynomialEmbedding_eval_class]
  change ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat ((1:Int):Rat) 1+
    RepresentedPolynomial.certClass ⟨J.val,J.property⟩*0=1
  rw [show ((1:Int):Rat)=1 by decide +kernel,ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat_one]
  grind only

private theorem rows_equivalent (J : Scalar) :
    RepresentedPolynomial.Equivalent
      ((List.ofFn integerHeckeIntegerRow41).map (fun p =>
        RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding p) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩))
      (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 J) := by
  rw [List.map_ofFn]
  apply RepresentedPolynomial.equivalent_ofFn
  intro i
  change (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding (integerHeckeIntegerRow41 i))
    ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).raw.Equiv (integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41 J i).raw
  by_cases hi : i.val=42
  · simp only [integerHeckeIntegerRow41,integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41,if_pos hi]
    exact one_eval J
  · simp only [integerHeckeIntegerRow41,integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41,if_neg hi]
    exact integerPrincipalPartPolynomialList_eval _ _ J

/-- Flattening the bivariate diagonal preserves its actual Horner value
at every valid represented complex input. -/
theorem integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41_eval (J : Scalar) :
    (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41)
      ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).raw.Equiv
      (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 J)
        ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).raw :=
  equiv_trans (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41)
      ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).valid
    (RepresentedPolynomial.eval ((List.ofFn integerHeckeIntegerRow41).map (fun p =>
      RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding p) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩))
      ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).valid
    (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 J) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩).valid
    (integerPolynomialDiagonal_eval (List.ofFn integerHeckeIntegerRow41) ⟨J.val,J.property⟩)
    (RepresentedPolynomial.eval_equiv (rows_equivalent J) (equiv_refl _ J.property))

/-- The concrete CM value is an exact root of a literal integer polynomial
constructed from the actual modular correspondence. -/
theorem cmJValue163_integer_diagonal_root :
    RepresentedPolynomial.Root (integerPolynomialEmbedding integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41)
      ⟨cmJValue163.val,cmJValue163.property⟩ :=
  equiv_trans (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerPolynomialEmbedding integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41)
      ⟨cmJValue163.val,cmJValue163.property⟩).valid
    (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 cmJValue163)
      ⟨cmJValue163.val,cmJValue163.property⟩).valid
    RepresentedPolynomial.zero.valid (integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41_eval cmJValue163)

  have hw := hN N (Nat.le_refl N)
  have hl := cmJGrowthDeficit163_lower 0 N
  change (1/100000000000000:Rat)≤(cmJGrowthDeficit163.compute N).hi at hl
  unfold QInterval.width at hw
  refine ⟨N,?_⟩
  change 0<(cmJGrowthDeficit163.compute N).lo
  grind only

/-- The represented deficit from the integer occurring in the discriminant-163 example. -/
def cmIntegerGrowthDeficit163 : RealRaw :=
  RealRaw.add (RealRaw.ofRat 262537412640768744) (RealRaw.neg cmGrowthValue163)

theorem cmIntegerGrowthDeficit163_valid : cmIntegerGrowthDeficit163.Valid :=
  RealRaw.add_valid (RealRaw.ofRat_valid _) (RealRaw.neg_valid (realPart_valid (entireExponentialValue cmGrowthExponent163).property))

/-- The CM value identity, when proved, identifies the actual j deficit with the integer deficit. -/
theorem cmIntegerGrowthDeficit163_agreement_of_cm_value
    (hcm : cmJValue163.val.Equiv (ofQComplex ⟨-((640320:Rat)^3),0⟩)) :
    cmJGrowthDeficit163.Equiv cmIntegerGrowthDeficit163 := by
  let t : Scalar := ⟨add (neg (entireExponentialValue cmGrowthExponent163).val) (ofQComplex ⟨744,0⟩),
    add_valid (neg_valid (entireExponentialValue cmGrowthExponent163).property) (ofQComplex_valid _)⟩
  have he := RealRaw.neg_equiv (realPart_equiv
    (FunctionTheory.sub_congr hcm (equiv_refl t.val t.property)))
  have hc : (RealRaw.neg (sub (ofQComplex ⟨-((640320:Rat)^3),0⟩) t.val).realPart).Equiv
      cmIntegerGrowthDeficit163 := by
    intro n
    apply (RealRaw.compareAt_overlap_iff _ _ n n).mpr
    have ho := RealRaw.interval_order_of_valid cmGrowthValue163
      (realPart_valid (entireExponentialValue cmGrowthExponent163).property) n
    have hk : -(-((640320:Rat)^3))+744=262537412640768744 := by decide +kernel
    change (-( -((640320:Rat)^3)+ -(-(cmGrowthValue163.compute n).hi+744))≤
        262537412640768744+ -(cmGrowthValue163.compute n).lo) ∧
      (262537412640768744+ -(cmGrowthValue163.compute n).hi≤
        -( -((640320:Rat)^3)+ -(-(cmGrowthValue163.compute n).lo+744)))
    constructor <;> grind only
  exact RealRaw.equiv_trans cmJGrowthDeficit163_valid
    (RealRaw.neg_valid (realPart_valid (sub_valid (ofQComplex_valid _) t.property)))
    cmIntegerGrowthDeficit163_valid he hc

/-- The proved analytic estimates imply the number-theoretic deficit bounds once the exact CM value is established. -/
theorem cmIntegerGrowthDeficit163_bounds_of_cm_value
    (hcm : cmJValue163.val.Equiv (ofQComplex ⟨-((640320:Rat)^3),0⟩)) :
    (RealRaw.ofRat (1/100000000000000)).Le cmIntegerGrowthDeficit163 ∧
      cmIntegerGrowthDeficit163.Le (RealRaw.ofRat (9/10000000000000)) := by
  have he := cmIntegerGrowthDeficit163_agreement_of_cm_value hcm
  constructor
  · exact RealRaw.le_trans cmJGrowthDeficit163_valid cmJGrowthDeficit163_lower
      (RealRaw.le_of_equiv cmJGrowthDeficit163_valid cmIntegerGrowthDeficit163_valid he)
  · exact RealRaw.le_trans cmJGrowthDeficit163_valid
      (RealRaw.le_of_equiv cmIntegerGrowthDeficit163_valid cmJGrowthDeficit163_valid (RealRaw.equiv_symm he))
      cmJGrowthDeficit163_upper

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.ImaginaryUnitAlgebra

/-! The quadratic equation of the executable CM point. -/
namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open RiemannHilbert
set_option maxRecDepth 8192

def cmPoint163Value : ScalarAlgebra.Value :=
  ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw cmPoint163 cmPoint163_valid

private def halfValue : ScalarAlgebra.Value := ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (1/2) 1

private theorem half_twice : halfValue+halfValue=1 := by
  unfold halfValue
  rw [ComplexRawQuotient.add_scaleRat]
  have h : (1/2:Rat)+1/2=1 := by decide +kernel
  rw [h,ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat_one]

theorem cmPoint163Value_formula :
    cmPoint163Value=ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (1/2)
      (1+imaginaryUnitValue*sqrt163Value) := by
  have hi := mulI_class (⟨sqrt163Complex,sqrt163Complex_valid⟩ : Scalar)
  change ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (ComplexRaw.imaginaryAxis sqrt163)
    (ComplexRaw.imaginaryAxis_valid sqrt163_valid)=imaginaryUnitValue*sqrt163Value at hi
  change ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (1/2)
    (1+ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw (ComplexRaw.imaginaryAxis sqrt163)
      (ComplexRaw.imaginaryAxis_valid sqrt163_valid)) = _
  rw [hi]

theorem cmPoint163Value_quadratic :
    cmPoint163Value*cmPoint163Value=cmPoint163Value-41 := by
  have hform := cmPoint163Value_formula
  have hscale : ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat (1/2)
      (1+imaginaryUnitValue*sqrt163Value)=halfValue*(1+imaginaryUnitValue*sqrt163Value) := by
    unfold halfValue
    rw [← ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat_mul]
    congr 1
    grind
  rw [hscale] at hform
  have hs := sqrt163Value_square
  have hi := imaginaryUnitValue_square
  have hh := half_twice
  have ht : 2*(cmPoint163Value*cmPoint163Value-cmPoint163Value+41)=0 := by grind
  have hm := congrArg (fun x : ScalarAlgebra.Value => halfValue*x) ht
  grind

theorem cmPoint163_quadratic :
    (ComplexRaw.mul cmPoint163 cmPoint163).Equiv
      (integerAffine 1 (-41) cmPoint163) := by
  apply ComplexRawQuotient.equiv_of_ofRaw_eq
    (hleft := ComplexRaw.mul_valid cmPoint163_valid cmPoint163_valid)
    (hright := integerAffine_valid _ _ cmPoint163_valid)
  rw [ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_mul,
    integerAffine_class 1 (-41) (⟨cmPoint163,cmPoint163_valid⟩ : Scalar)]
  have h := cmPoint163Value_quadratic
  change cmPoint163Value*cmPoint163Value =
    ((1:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value)*cmPoint163Value+((-41:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value)
  grind

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.IntegerHeckePolynomialRecovery41
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.Hecke41CoefficientDegreeVanishing
import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.CMHeckeRootPolynomial41

namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open ComplexRaw RiemannHilbert FunctionTheory

private theorem coefficient_getD (p : RepresentedPolynomial.Coefficients) (k : Nat) :
    RepresentedPolynomial.coefficient p k=p[k]?.getD RepresentedPolynomial.zero := by
  induction p generalizing k with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a p ih => cases k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k => exact ih k

/-- Finite coefficient agreement proves agreement of literal represented
polynomials, including their actual Horner evaluations. -/
theorem representedPolynomial_equivalent_of_coefficients
    (p q : RepresentedPolynomial.Coefficients) (hlen : p.length=q.length)
    (hc : ∀ i, i<p.length → (RepresentedPolynomial.coefficient p i).raw.Equiv
      (RepresentedPolynomial.coefficient q i).raw) : RepresentedPolynomial.Equivalent p q := by
  induction p generalizing q with
  | nil => cases q with
    | nil => exact .nil
    | cons b q => simp at hlen
  | cons a p ih => cases q with
    | nil => simp at hlen
    | cons b q =>
      refine .cons (hc 0 (by simp)) (ih q (by simpa using hlen) ?_)
      intro i hi
      exact hc (i+1) (by simp; omega)

/-- An integer polynomial in the first j argument supplies each coefficient
of the recovered degree-forty-two polynomial in the second argument. -/
def integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41 (J : Scalar) (i : Fin 43) : ComplexCert :=
  if i.val=42 then RepresentedPolynomial.one else
    ⟨integerPrincipalPartJPolynomial J (integerHeckePrincipalCutoff41 (41-i.val))
      (integerHeckePrincipalPolynomialCoefficients41 (41-i.val)),
      integerPrincipalPartJPolynomial_valid _ _ _⟩

/-- The literal recovered polynomial, with executable integer coefficient
polynomials and its monic leading term, in ascending second-argument order. -/
def integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 (J : Scalar) : RepresentedPolynomial.Coefficients :=
  List.ofFn (integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41 J)

theorem integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41_length (J : Scalar) :
    (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 J).length=43 := by simp [integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41]

private theorem recovered_coefficient (J : Scalar) (i : Fin 43) :
    RepresentedPolynomial.coefficient (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 J) i.val=
      integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41 J i := by
  rw [coefficient_getD]
  change (List.ofFn (integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41 J))[i.val]?.getD
    RepresentedPolynomial.zero=integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41 J i
  rw [List.getElem?_ofFn]
  simp only [dif_pos i.isLt,Option.getD_some]

/-- The entire actual root polynomial is recovered, not merely its individual
auxiliary coefficient functions. -/
theorem integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41_equivalent (z : Scalar)
    (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) :
    let hd : hecke41CommonDomain z := ⟨hz,fun i =>
      latticeJMap_global_domain (hecke41Point i z) (hecke41Point_upper i z hz)⟩
    RepresentedPolynomial.Equivalent (hecke41RootPolynomial z hd.2)
      (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 (latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz))) := by
  let hd : hecke41CommonDomain z := ⟨hz,fun i =>
    latticeJMap_global_domain (hecke41Point i z) (hecke41Point_upper i z hz)⟩
  let J := latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz)
  apply representedPolynomial_equivalent_of_coefficients
    (hecke41RootPolynomial z hd.2) (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 J)
    (by rw [hecke41RootPolynomial_length,integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41_length])
  intro i hi
  rw [hecke41RootPolynomial_length] at hi
  rw [recovered_coefficient J ⟨i,hi⟩]
  by_cases he : i=42
  · subst i
    simp only [integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41,if_pos rfl]
    exact equiv_trans (RepresentedPolynomial.coefficient (hecke41RootPolynomial z hd.2) 42).valid
      ((hecke41PolynomialCoefficient 42).value z hd).property RepresentedPolynomial.one.valid
      (equiv_symm (hecke41PolynomialCoefficient_value 42 z hd))
      (hecke41PolynomialCoefficient_leading z hd)
  · have hil : i≤41 := by omega
    simp only [integerHeckeRecoveredCoefficient41,if_neg he]
    have h := integerHeckeRootPolynomialCoefficient41_recovery (41-i) (by omega) z hz
    rw [Nat.sub_sub_self hil] at h
    exact h

/-- Literal Horner evaluation of the recovered integer-coefficient polynomial
agrees with the actual analytic correspondence at every second argument. -/
theorem integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41_eval (z : Scalar)
    (hz : InUpperHalfPlane z.val) (x : ComplexCert) :
    let hd : hecke41CommonDomain z := ⟨hz,fun i =>
      latticeJMap_global_domain (hecke41Point i z) (hecke41Point_upper i z hz)⟩
    (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (hecke41RootPolynomial z hd.2) x).raw.Equiv
      (RepresentedPolynomial.eval (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41
        (latticeJMap.eval z (latticeJMap_global_domain z hz))) x).raw :=
  RepresentedPolynomial.eval_equiv (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41_equivalent z hz)
    (equiv_refl _ x.valid)

/-- The actual CM value satisfies the recovered integer bivariate polynomial
on the diagonal. No algebraicity or singular-modulus value is assumed. -/
theorem cmJValue163_recovered_polynomial_root :
    RepresentedPolynomial.Root (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41 cmJValue163)
      ⟨cmJValue163.val,cmJValue163.property⟩ :=
  RepresentedPolynomial.root_congr
    (integerHeckeRecoveredPolynomial41_equivalent cmScalar163 cmPoint163_upper)
    (equiv_refl _ cmJValue163.property) cmHeckeRootPolynomial41_cm_root

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.Hecke41PrincipalRowAgreement

namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.PackedIntegerPolynomialProduct
set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option maxRecDepth 100000

def hecke41CandidateIntegerRow (i : Fin 43) : List Int :=
  if i.val=42 then [1] else
    integerPrincipalPartPolynomialList (integerHeckePrincipalCutoff41 (41-i.val))
      (integerArrayCoefficient (hecke41PrincipalRowRow (41-i.val)))
      (integerHeckePrincipalCutoff41 (41-i.val)+1)

/-- The already checked triangular rows produce exactly the supplied diagonal. -/
theorem hecke41PrincipalRows_diagonal_checked :
    integerPolynomialDiagonal (List.ofFn hecke41CandidateIntegerRow)=
      hecke41DiagonalCandidate := by
  decide +kernel

private theorem principal_list_prefix_equal (a b : Coefficients) (M N : Nat)
    (h : ∀ n, n<N → a n=b n) :
    integerPrincipalPartPolynomialList M a N=integerPrincipalPartPolynomialList M b N := by
  induction N with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [integerPrincipalPartPolynomialList,integerPrincipalPartPolynomialList,
      ih (fun n hn => h n (by omega)),h N (by omega)]

/-- Exact equality of the actual diagonal and supplied integer polynomial
from the checked Newton prefix; all principal elimination choices are internal. -/
theorem hecke41Diagonal_agreement_of_newton
    (hnewton : ∀ k n, k≤41 → n<1723 → hecke41ExpandedNewtonCandidate k n=
      integerOrbitNewtonCoefficient41 integerJWeightedCoefficients 40 k n) :
    integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41=hecke41DiagonalCandidate := by
  rw [← hecke41PrincipalRows_diagonal_checked]
  unfold integerHeckeDiagonalPolynomial41
  congr 1
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext i
  unfold integerHeckeIntegerRow41 hecke41CandidateIntegerRow
  by_cases hi : i.val=42
  · simp only [if_pos hi]
  · simp only [if_neg hi]
    apply principal_list_prefix_equal
    intro n hn
    exact (hecke41PrincipalRow_agreement_of_newton hnewton (41-i.val) n
      (by omega) (by omega)).symm

/-- The actual CM value is a root of the verified supplied polynomial once
the Newton witness prefix has been checked. -/
theorem cmJValue163_candidate_diagonal_root_of_newton
    (hnewton : ∀ k n, k≤41 → n<1723 → hecke41ExpandedNewtonCandidate k n=
      integerOrbitNewtonCoefficient41 integerJWeightedCoefficients 40 k n) :
    RepresentedPolynomial.Root (integerPolynomialEmbedding hecke41DiagonalCandidate)
      ⟨cmJValue163.val,cmJValue163.property⟩ := by
  rw [← hecke41Diagonal_agreement_of_newton hnewton]
  exact cmJValue163_integer_diagonal_root

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.PackedIntegerPolynomialProduct

import ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms.Hecke41DiagonalCandidateData

namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open RiemannHilbert

private theorem shift_class (p : List Int) (X : ScalarAlgebra.Value) :
    integerPolynomialClass (0::p) X=X*integerPolynomialClass p X := by
  change ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat ((0:Int):Rat) 1+X*integerPolynomialClass p X=_
  rw [show ((0:Int):Rat)=0 by decide +kernel,ComplexRawQuotient.scaleRat_zeroScalar]
  grind only

private theorem scale_class (p : List Int) (a : Int) (X : ScalarAlgebra.Value) :
    integerPolynomialClass (p.map (fun b => a*b)) X=
      (a:ScalarAlgebra.Value)*integerPolynomialClass p X := by
  induction p with
  | nil => change (0:ScalarAlgebra.Value)=(a:ScalarAlgebra.Value)*0; grind only
  | cons b p ih =>
    change ((a*b:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value)+X*integerPolynomialClass (p.map (fun b => a*b)) X=
      (a:ScalarAlgebra.Value)*((b:ScalarAlgebra.Value)+X*integerPolynomialClass p X)
    rw [ih]; grind

/-- The checked finite squared-factor identity evaluates exactly at every
represented complex value. -/
theorem hecke41DiagonalCandidate_factor_class (X : ScalarAlgebra.Value) :
    integerPolynomialClass hecke41DiagonalCandidate X=
      (X-((-(640320:Int)^3):ScalarAlgebra.Value))^2*
        integerPolynomialClass hecke41DiagonalCandidateQuotient X := by
  rw [hecke41DiagonalCandidate_factorization]
  unfold hecke41DiagonalCandidateFactorPolynomial
  dsimp only
  rw [integerPolynomialAdd_class,integerPolynomialAdd_class,
    shift_class,shift_class,shift_class,scale_class,scale_class]
  grind only

end ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms

namespace ComputableAnalysis.ModularForms
open RiemannHilbert

/-- Exact affine relation for the actual executable CM interval parameter. -/
theorem cmJIsolationParameter163_substitution :
    let T := realAxisClass cmJIsolationParameter163 cmJIsolationParameter163_valid
    let X := realAxisClass cmJValue163.val.realPart (ComplexRaw.realPart_valid cmJValue163.property)
    (1+T)*X=((-2305843009213693952:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value)+
      ((-144115188075854872:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value)*T := by
  dsimp only
  have hN : realAxisClass cmJIsolationNumerator163 cmJIsolationNumerator163_valid=
      realAxisClass cmJValue163.val.realPart (ComplexRaw.realPart_valid cmJValue163.property)-
        ((-2305843009213693952:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value) := by
    unfold cmJIsolationNumerator163
    have hc := realAxisClass_int (-2305843009213693952)
    rw [show ((-2305843009213693952:Int):Rat)=(-2305843009213693952:Rat) by decide +kernel] at hc
    rw [realAxisClass_sub cmJValue163.val.realPart (RealRaw.ofRat (-2305843009213693952))
      (ComplexRaw.realPart_valid cmJValue163.property) (RealRaw.ofRat_valid _),
      hc]
  have hD : realAxisClass cmJIsolationDenominator163 cmJIsolationDenominator163_valid=
      ((-144115188075854872:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value)-
        realAxisClass cmJValue163.val.realPart (ComplexRaw.realPart_valid cmJValue163.property) := by
    unfold cmJIsolationDenominator163
    have hc := realAxisClass_int (-144115188075854872)
    rw [show ((-144115188075854872:Int):Rat)=(-144115188075854872:Rat) by decide +kernel] at hc
    rw [realAxisClass_sub (RealRaw.ofRat (-144115188075854872)) cmJValue163.val.realPart
      (RealRaw.ofRat_valid _) (ComplexRaw.realPart_valid cmJValue163.property),
      hc]
  have hI := ComplexRawQuotient.ofRaw_eq_ofRaw
    (hleft := ComplexRaw.ofRealRaw_valid _
      (RealRaw.mul_valid cmJIsolationDenominator163_valid cmJIsolationInverse163_valid))
    (hright := ComplexRaw.ofRealRaw_valid RealRaw.one (RealRaw.ofRat_valid 1))
    (ComplexRaw.ofRealRaw_equiv_of_equiv (y := RealRaw.one)
      (RealRaw.mul_valid cmJIsolationDenominator163_valid cmJIsolationInverse163_valid)
      (RealRaw.ofRat_valid 1) cmJIsolationInverse163_product_identity)
  change realAxisClass (RealRaw.mul cmJIsolationDenominator163 cmJIsolationInverse163)
      (RealRaw.mul_valid cmJIsolationDenominator163_valid cmJIsolationInverse163_valid)=
      realAxisClass RealRaw.one (RealRaw.ofRat_valid 1) at hI
  rw [realAxisClass_mul _ _ cmJIsolationDenominator163_valid cmJIsolationInverse163_valid,hD] at hI
  have hOne : realAxisClass RealRaw.one (RealRaw.ofRat_valid 1)=(1:ScalarAlgebra.Value) := by
    have h := realAxisClass_int 1
    change realAxisClass RealRaw.one (RealRaw.ofRat_valid 1)=((1:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value) at h
    rw [h]; grind only
  rw [hOne] at hI
  have hT : realAxisClass cmJIsolationParameter163 cmJIsolationParameter163_valid=
      (realAxisClass cmJValue163.val.realPart (ComplexRaw.realPart_valid cmJValue163.property)-
        ((-2305843009213693952:Int):ScalarAlgebra.Value))*
      realAxisClass cmJIsolationInverse163 cmJIsolationInverse163_valid := by
    change realAxisClass (RealRaw.mul cmJIsolationNumerator163 cmJIsolationInverse163)
      (RealRaw.mul_valid cmJIsolationNumerator163_valid cmJIsolationInverse163_valid)=_
    rw [realAxisClass_mul _ _ cmJIsolationNumerator163_valid cmJIsolationInverse163_valid,hN]
  rw [hT]
